note: Each device's Ed25519 seed is SHA-256 of 'frasil spec example/<prefix>/<name>/ed25519', its ML-DSA-65 and X-Wing seeds crypto.md's fixture derivations, and its member ID the device ID of the three keys. A rotation's content key is SHA-256 of 'frasil spec example/<prefix>/<label>/content-key', the genesis's label being 'genesis'. history_prefixes gives each history's <prefix>; a case's list_prefixes and team_prefix give those of the other logs it reads. Rotation slots and key-event bodies hold minimal stand-in payloads (keys.md) that pass its checks: most rotate (read and upload commitments only), a key event that responds is a grant rotation, and one only delivers. A team whose rotations a notice names commits to real grant keys, each derived from '<prefix>/<label>/grant-seed'.
